item.description: Finding the underlying dimension of the dataset. Basically the manifold dimension OOD image should be distant from the the manifold How to find this distance of this img from the manifold. Use this to design the test statistic Global idea of underlying manifold Stein’s unbiased estimate. Try the ID vs OOD things on the CelebA dataset

We need to check scenarios where the learnt kernel will actually bring about smth better compared to just pooling. Ablate over the gains given by each term of the test statistic Pooling seems to be killing the signal the first term of the u-stat is qutie large for both null and alt dist. samples The remaining terms should be large in case of alt and small in case of the null distribution Read the EigenScore and KLIP papers what if we do discrepancy on a patchwise basis on the main image.
